mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a construction project with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your project. This is followed by proposal development, contract signing, and project planning, which includes detailed scheduling and material selection. Construction then commences, with the general contractor overseeing all trades and site management. Regular communication and site visits are part of the process, concluding with a final walk-through and project completion.
